description.text: AI-written synthesis of the official page retrieved in this pass, prepared by the collecting assistant: Dorm Room Fund | First Check for Student Founders Apply Portfolio Team How we work Join the team The first yes. We write the first check for founders still in school or just out. 339 + companies $ 14 B+ in follow-on capital 12 + years backing student founders Each one started where you are The first door is the hardest. We hold it open. ← → Developer Tools · MIT, 2022 Michael Truell We backed Michael before he had an idea, let alone a product. The bet was not on a category or a deck. It was on a builder we knew would keep going. Cursor Where coding dissolves into conversation. Healthcare · University of Pennsylvania, 2019 Toni Oloko & Daniel Hanover Before the pitch deck was the factory. Toni moved from thesis to physical reality while he was still finishing his degree, and we had a front row seat. Dandy Where dentistry catches up to software. Healthcare · Stanford & USC, 2016 Tanay Tandon & Deepika Bodapati Tanay and Deepika were already building across the clinical frontier as students. Their first clinical trial spotted a leukemia diagnosis before the hospital confirmed it.
